micro_interview.question: A model performs well in cross-validation but degrades sharply after deployment. Give four distinct hypotheses and, for each, one diagnostic test you would run before changing the model.
micro_interview.demonstrate: Separate data leakage, distribution shift, overfitting or flawed validation, pipeline/implementation bugs and monitoring issues; diagnose before model tinkering.
micro_interview.practice: Take 7 minutes to build a hypothesis→test table, then give a 3-minute English answer. Do not jump straight to a more complex model.

life_career_actions.suggestion: Submit Barclays Quant Analytics today rather than using the 25/09 deadline as a target; the vacancy may close early and sponsorship is explicitly supported for eligible candidates.
Spend 45 minutes converting one TFM result into a reproducible English GitHub mini-case with problem, method, experiment, result and limitations.
Consider a 30–45 minute movement or sport block plus one screen-free break after the deadline-critical application work, before returning to technical practice.
